key_insight: The paper shows that optimal gate-packing can partition the Quantum Fourier Transform into distributed quantum circuits with lower entanglement cost while preserving the same unitary operation.
engineering_relevance: This improves the practicality of multi-QPU quantum systems by reducing e-bit generation overhead for a core subroutine used in phase estimation and quantum arithmetic.
method: Formulate QFT partitioning around minimizing e-bit count via optimal gate-packing.
Compare the proposed scheme with prior analytical QFT partitioning methods.
Benchmark against general-purpose circuit partitioning algorithms and implement the result on quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports both comparative evaluation against existing partitioners and hardware implementation of the partitioned circuit as validation.
watch_item: The approach depends on distributed entanglement generation and teleportation, so real-device latency and hardware noise may reduce the theoretical partitioning gains.
paper_title: Towards an Optimally Distributed Quantum Fourier Transform Circuit
